newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: U.S. Commerce's Daley arrives in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Commerce's Daley arrives in Argentina.

text.p: U.S. Commerce Secretary William Daley arrived in Argentina Thursday for a three-day official visit during which he will meet President Carlos Menem, Foreign Minister Guido di Tella and Economy Minister Roque Fernandez.

Daley made no comments to reporters on his arrival from Belo Horizonte, Brazil, where deputy ministers from across the Americas are drafting an agreement to set up a Free Trade Area of the Americas (FTAA). After lunch with Di Tella, Daley was meeting Fernandez and also planned to hold talks with Menem at 1930 local (2230 GMT).
